LanguageData.LP_LS_Mending.label: mending
LanguageData.LP_LS_Mending.description: Lake seal (tier 1 spell, Intelligence, lake breath 1): one piece of apparel or weapon recovers 30% durability. When targeting a person, mends the most worn piece on them; you can also target an item on the ground directly.
LanguageData.LP_LS_PurifyFood.label: purify food and drink
LanguageData.LP_LS_PurifyFood.description: Lake seal (tier 1 spell, Wisdom, lake breath 1): removes the target's food poisoning; no food poisoning for 2 days afterwards.
LanguageData.LP_LS_Alarm.label: alarm
LanguageData.LP_LS_Alarm.description: Lake seal (tier 1 spell, Intelligence, lake breath 1): draw an invisible rune of radius 6 at the target that lasts 3 days; when an enemy enters, it sends a letter and wakes the colonists (disappears after triggering once).
LanguageData.LP_LS_Darkvision.label: darkvision
LanguageData.LP_LS_Darkvision.description: Lake seal (tier 1 spell, Wisdom, lake breath 1): the target ignores darkness penalties to work and aiming for 1 day (duration lengthens with the casting ability).
LanguageData.LP_LS_Longstrider.label: longstrider
LanguageData.LP_LS_Longstrider.description: Lake seal (tier 1 spell, Intelligence, lake breath 1): target move speed +15% for 1 day (duration lengthens with the casting ability).
LanguageData.LP_LS_Thunderwave.label: thunderwave
LanguageData.LP_LS_Thunderwave.description: Lake seal (tier 1 spell, Intelligence, lake breath 2): a 4-cell cone ahead, 8 blunt damage, knocks back 2 cells, 30% chance to stun for 2 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_LS_ArcaneLock.label: arcane lock
LanguageData.LP_LS_ArcaneLock.description: Lake seal (tier 2 spell, Intelligence, lake breath 1): lock a door for 5 days: enemies bashing it deal ×0.33 damage.
LanguageData.LP_LS_Augury.label: augury
LanguageData.LP_LS_Augury.description: Lake seal (tier 2 spell, Wisdom, lake breath 2): success 60% + Wisdom modifier × 3%: tells you the type and rough timing of the biggest threat within 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_LS_FalseLife.label: false life
LanguageData.LP_LS_FalseLife.description: Lake seal (tier 2 spell, Intelligence, lake breath 1): the target gets a shield absorbing 20 damage (rising with the casting ability) for 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_LS_CreateFood.label: create food
LanguageData.LP_LS_CreateFood.description: Lake seal (tier 2 spell, Wisdom, lake breath 3): conjure 5 simple meals at your feet.
LanguageData.LP_LS_CalmMind.label: calm emotions
LanguageData.LP_LS_CalmMind.description: Lake seal (tier 2 spell, Charisma, lake breath 2): ends the target's non-violent mental break; with no break, the target gets mental break threshold -5% for 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_LS_Shatter.label: shatter
LanguageData.LP_LS_Shatter.description: Lake seal (tier 2 spell, Intelligence, lake breath 2): radius 2 at the target, 15 blunt damage; ×3 against mechanoids and buildings.
LanguageData.LP_LS_Counterspell.label: counterspell
LanguageData.LP_LS_Counterspell.description: Lake seal (tier 3 spell, Intelligence, lake breath 2): interrupt a psycast / class ability an enemy is channeling and silence it for 10 seconds; 50% success against legendary creatures.
LanguageData.LP_LS_TinyHut.label: tiny hut
LanguageData.LP_LS_TinyHut.description: Lake seal (tier 3 spell, Wisdom, lake breath 3): raise a force dome of radius 3 for 8 hours: blocks projectiles fired from outside, and those inside stay at a constant temperature; vanishes when the caster leaves the dome.
LanguageData.LP_LS_LakeBody.label: lakeland constitution
LanguageData.LP_LS_LakeBody.description: Lake seal passive (tier 1): comfortable temperature range widened by 8°C at each end.
LanguageData.LP_LS_ManaDigest.label: mana digestion
LanguageData.LP_LS_ScholarHeart.label: scholar's mind
LanguageData.LP_LS_ScholarHeart.description: Lake seal passive (tier 1): global learning speed +12%.
LanguageData.LP_LS_DreamlessSleep.label: dreamless sleep
LanguageData.LP_LS_DreamlessSleep.description: Lake seal passive (tier 1): rest fall rate -15%.
LanguageData.LP_LS_HealingFlow.label: healing flow
LanguageData.LP_LS_HealingFlow.description: Lake seal passive (tier 2): natural healing +20%, tend quality received +5%.
LanguageData.LP_LS_ArcaneResist.label: arcane resistance
LanguageData.LP_LS_ArcaneResist.description: Lake seal passive (tier 2): damage taken from class abilities, psycasts and magic items -15% (doesn't overlap with mind resistance: this covers damage, mind resistance covers control).
LanguageData.LP_LS_RuneSkin.label: rune skin
LanguageData.LP_LS_RuneSkin.description: Lake seal passive (tier 2): sharp and blunt armor +6%.
LanguageData.LP_LS_ManaConduit.label: mana conduit
LanguageData.LP_LS_ManaConduit.description: Lake seal passive (tier 2): each hit has a 15% chance to add 4 arcane damage.
LanguageData.LP_LS_LakeHeart.label: heart of the lake
LanguageData.LP_LS_LakeHeart.description: Lake seal passive (tier 3): max lake breath +1, recovery ×1.5.
LanguageData.LP_LS_WeaveSense.label: weave sense
LanguageData.LP_LS_WeaveSense.description: Lake seal passive (tier 3): invisible enemies within 8 cells are visible to you.
